caption: The drawing depicts a round, lidded container made of brown, textured material that resembles wood or metal. The lid of the container features geometric, faceted sections, two hinges, and a simple latch in the center front. A thin, upright cross is attached to the top center of the lid. The base of the container is slightly wider at the top and tapers towards the bottom, with a band of repeating oval-shaped decorations encircling it. The background is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or details. The artist’s name, "HARRY MANN WADDELL," appears in small capital letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Baptismal Font
